threat: Exfiltration of ePHI via vendor database
vulnerability: No pre-onboarding vetting; BAA never executed
remediation: Vendor freeze; collect SOC 2; execute BAA before data flow resumes

threat: Unverified e-Rx data flow between EHR and pharmacy
vulnerability: Regulated data path never mapped; transit encryption never verified
remediation: Map and classify the flow as ePHI-bearing; verify TLS 1.2+ before further dispensing

threat: MFA disabled on nursing EHR accounts
vulnerability: Confirmed-absent MFA on internet-facing clinical accounts
remediation: Enforce MFA on all clinical accounts; audit login history for compromise
